qualification.reason: The document is a Request for Quotes (RFQ) issued by the New York State Department of Taxation and Finance for GPS hardware and software, including submission deadlines, requirements, and award criteria.

quotes.quote: REQUEST FOR QUOTES
TITLE: GPS Hardware and Software
REQUEST FOR QUOTE NUMBER: 19-326
BID DUE DATE: October 8, 2019
Deadline for Submission of Quotes (Cover Page and Attachments 1-4) October 8, 2019 by 2:00 PM ET
The award will be made to the responsive and responsible Bidder who provides the lowest overall cost and meets all requirements set forth in this RFQ.

findings.title: Fleet GPS Upgrade Opportunity
findings.fact: The New York State Department of Taxation and Finance (DTF) seeks to upgrade GPS hardware and software for approximately 93 vehicles, with installation at three locations and a two-year agreement term.
findings.business_implication: This is a targeted fleet management opportunity requiring a current GPS product and installation services across three New York State sites.
findings.action_recommendation: Assess whether your hardware/software solution can meet the OBD-port installation and data continuity requirements for a fleet of this size.

quotes.quote: The New York State Department of Taxation and Finance (“DTF” or “Department”) has a need to monitor and manage a fleet of approximately ninety-three (93) vehicles. The current GPS hardware being utilized by the Department are GEOTAB GO7 devices, which are nearing end of life. DTF is seeking to upgrade the current GPS hardware and the associated software in order to maintain its current fleet management capabilities.

findings.title: Original Manufacturer or Authorized Reseller Required
findings.fact: Bids will not be considered unless the bidder is the original manufacturer or an authorized reseller of both the hardware and software, and is compliant with applicable laws and regulations.
findings.business_implication: Only qualified manufacturers/resellers can submit a responsive bid; resellers must have current authorization documentation.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify and be prepared to provide evidence of OEM/reseller status and legal compliance before bid submission.

quotes.quote:
Bids will not be considered unless the vendor submitting a bid meets the following minimum qualifications. The Bidder must:
• Be the original manufacturer or authorized reseller of the hardware and software to be provided; and
• Be compliant with all applicable laws and regulations related to providing these services.

ii. The Bidder is an original manufacturer or authorized reseller of the GPS devices and associated software and is compliant with all applicable laws and regulations related to providing these services.

findings.title: Email Submission with Mandatory Attachments by Deadline
findings.fact: Responses must be emailed to BFS.Contracts@tax.ny.gov no later than October 8, 2019 at 2:00 PM ET, and must include the completed Cover Page and Attachments 1 through 4.
findings.business_implication: Failure to submit by email or to include all required attachments may render the bid non-responsive and rejected.
findings.action_recommendation: Prepare all forms in advance, confirm email delivery, and submit well before the deadline.

quotes.quote: Responses to this RFQ must be emailed to BFS.Contracts@tax.ny.gov no later than October 8, 2019 at 2:00 PM ET. Responses received by other methods or after the deadline may not be accepted.

Include the following completed forms in their submission:
oCover Page- Completed Cover Page of this RFQ
oAttachment 1- Quote Response Form
oAttachment 2- Offerer Understanding of, and Compliance with, Procurement Lobbying Guidelines
oAttachment 3- Offerer Disclosure of Prior Non-Responsibility Determinations
oAttachment 4- Offerer’s Certification of Compliance with State Finance Law 139-k (5)

findings.title: Procurement Schedule and Deadlines
findings.fact: The RFQ schedule includes: questions due September 25, 2019; Department responses published September 30, 2019; quote deadline October 8, 2019 at 2:00 PM ET; intent to award October 16, 2019; purchase order approximately 10 business days later.
findings.business_implication: Bidder has a narrow window for submitting questions and must align internal approval processes with the fixed deadlines.
findings.action_recommendation: Calendar all dates, submit questions by September 25, and prepare final pricing and forms well before October 8.

quotes.quote:
Deadline for Submission of Bidder Questions September 25, 2019
Department Responses to Bidder Questions Published September 30, 2019
Deadline for Submission of Quotes (Cover Page and Attachments 1-4) October 8, 2019 by 2:00 PM ET
Anticipated Notification of Intent to Award October 16, 2019
Issuance of Purchase Order Approximately 10 business days after Notification of Intent to Award

findings.title: Lowest Overall Cost Award with Tie-Breaker
findings.fact: Award will be made to the responsive and responsible bidder with the lowest overall cost, calculated using Attachment 1; if tie bids are received, the earliest bid received wins.
findings.business_implication: This is a low-price procurement; technical compliance is a threshold requirement rather than a scored factor.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure your pricing on Attachment 1 is competitive and submit early to gain an advantage in the event of a tie.

quotes.quote: The award will be made to the responsive and responsible Bidder who provides the lowest overall cost and meets all requirements set forth in this RFQ. The total cost will be calculated using the information provided on Attachment 1, Quote Response Form.
In the event tie bids are received by the Department, the earliest bid received shall determine the winner.

findings.title: Prices Guaranteed for the Term
findings.fact: Prices submitted on the bid must be guaranteed by the vendor for the entire two-year term of the Agreement.
findings.business_implication: No price escalation is allowed; bidder must absorb cost increases over the full term.
findings.action_recommendation: Build in adequate contingency for hardware, software, and support costs for the two-year period.

quotes.quote: Prices as they appear on submitted bids must be guaranteed by the vendor for the term of the Agreement.

findings.title: No-Cost Maintenance and Replacement Obligation
findings.fact: If any devices require maintenance or replacement (not caused by DTF employee negligence), the bidder must provide devices and/or services at no cost within 30 days of DTF notification.
findings.business_implication: The bidder carries a potentially significant financial obligation for hardware failures and maintenance throughout the term, with no stated cost cap.
findings.action_recommendation: Evaluate device reliability and support costs, include replacement risk in pricing, and seek clarification on the scope of 'maintenance or replacement' during the question period.

quotes.quote: If any devices are identified by the Department to require maintenance or replacement, not resulting from the negligence of any DTF employee, the devices and/or services must be provided to the Department at no cost within 30 days of the Department’s notification.

findings.title: Termination if Replacement Devices Are Unacceptable
findings.fact: If the GPS model becomes unsupported during the term, the awarded bidder must work with DTF to replace the devices, and DTF reserves the right to terminate the Agreement if such replacement devices are deemed unacceptable.
findings.business_implication: The bidder may be forced to supply replacement devices at its own cost, and failure to provide acceptable replacements could lead to termination.
findings.action_recommendation: Assess product lifecycle stability, plan for technology refreshes, and attempt to negotiate replacement/termination terms in the contract.

quotes.quote: If the model of the GPS devices becomes unsupported during the term, the awarded Bidder must work with the Department to replace the devices. The Department reserves the right to terminate the Agreement if such replacement devices are deemed unacceptable.

findings.title: State's Liability Limited to Appropriated Funds
findings.fact: Under the Standard Clauses, the State has no liability under the contract beyond funds appropriated and available for the contract.
findings.business_implication: The bidder's ability to recover payment is contingent on the continued availability of appropriated funds; the State is not liable if funds lapse.
findings.action_recommendation: Understand appropriations risk and consider it in your pricing and risk assessment.

quotes.quote: In accordance with Section 41 of the State Finance Law, the State shall have no liability under this contract to the Contractor or to anyone else beyond funds appropriated and available for this contract.

findings.title: State Set-Off Rights
findings.fact: The State has all common law, equitable and statutory rights of set-off, including the option to withhold contract moneys for any amounts owed to the State, such as tax delinquencies or fee delinquencies.
findings.business_implication: The State may offset payments due to the bidder against unrelated debts, potentially affecting cash flow.
findings.action_recommendation: Ensure there are no outstanding state liabilities and monitor state set-off notices during the contract.

quotes.quote: The State shall have all of its common law, equitable and statutory rights of set-off. These rights shall include, but not be limited to, the State's option to withhold for the purposes of set-off any moneys due to the Contractor under this contract up to any amounts due and owing to the State with regard to this contract, any other contract with any State department or agency, including any contract for a term commencing prior to the term of this contract, plus any amounts due and owing to the State for any other reason including, without limitation, tax delinquencies, fee delinquencies or monetary penalties relative thereto.

findings.title: NYS Vendor File Registration Required Prior to Award
findings.fact: Prior to being awarded an Agreement, the bidder must be registered in the New York State Vendor File administered by the Office of the State Comptroller; if not registered, the bidder must request a Vendor ID from DTF, preferably in advance of bidding.
findings.business_implication: Failure to complete vendor registration could delay or prevent contract award.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify registration status or submit the OSC Substitute W-9 to DTF immediately to obtain a Vendor ID.

quotes.quote: Prior to being awarded an Agreement pursuant to this RFQ, the Bidder(s) must be registered in the New York State Vendor File (Vendor File) administered by the Office of the State Comptroller (OSC).

findings.title: Bidder Must Notify DTF of Any Precluding Terms
findings.fact: The RFQ states that it is incumbent on the prospective bidder to notify the designated contacts of any term, condition, etc., that precludes the vendor from submitting a bid.
findings.business_implication: The bidder is expected to proactively identify any objectionable or bid-precluding terms rather than remaining silent.
findings.action_recommendation: Review the RFQ thoroughly and raise any blocking issues through the official question process.

quotes.quote: IT IS INCUMBENT ON THE PROSPECTIVE BIDDER TO NOTIFY THE DESIGNATED CONTACTS OF ANY TERM, CONDITION, ETC. THAT PRECLUDES THE VENDOR FROM SUBMITTING A BID.

findings.title: Undefined 'Most Current Version' Requirement
findings.fact: The hardware must be 'the most current version of the GPS tracking module,' but the RFQ does not define a specific model, version, or reference date for determining what is 'most current'.
findings.business_implication: The bidder may offer a product that DTF later considers not 'most current' at the time of evaluation or delivery, creating compliance risk.
findings.action_recommendation: Seek clarification from DTF on the exact product/version expected as of the bid deadline.

quotes.quote:
The hardware device(s) must:
• Be the most current version of the GPS tracking module;

findings.title: No Express Indemnification or Liability Cap Found
findings.fact: Unable to determine from the available document evidence whether the contract includes an express indemnification clause or a monetary cap on contractor liability.
findings.business_implication: The bidder faces potential unquantified liability, especially given the unlimited no-cost replacement obligation identified above.
findings.action_recommendation: Request a copy of the proposed contract terms and clarify indemnification and limitation of liability during the question period.
